title: Wickhollow square well
subject: Subject: the town well, seen flat from the front: a round wall of grey fitted stones about 2 m across on a low stepped round base, a curved iron arch over it with a small hanging iron lantern glowing warm and a chain going down, short black iron posts round it joined by hanging chains. Night colours apart from the lantern.
use: The well in the middle of the night square fight.

title: Iron lamp post
subject: Subject: one black iron street lamp, seen flat from the front, about 3.5 m high: a stepped base, a slim post with a ring halfway up, a curled bracket at the top from which a four-sided iron lantern hangs, its glass glowing warm amber.
use: The lamp posts round the night square.

title: Market stall with striped awning
subject: Subject: the market stall, seen flat from the front: a wooden counter of dark planks with two closed crates on it, corner posts, and a sloping awning of plum and muted gold stripes with a scalloped front edge. About 3 m wide.
use: The stall at the left of the night square.

title: The forge front
subject: Subject: the town forge, seen flat from the front: a half-timbered building with dark posts and pale plaster, a plum-red tile roof and a brick chimney, a shield sign with crossed hammers, and an open front under a little roof where the hearth glows orange, an anvil before it and a ladder leaning on the wall. About 9 m wide.
use: The forge at the back left of the night square.

title: The chapel front
subject: Subject: the small town chapel, seen flat from the front: grey stone walls, a square bell tower with a bronze bell and a cross on top, a round red rose window, an arched wooden door with iron hinges, a lantern glowing each side of the door, roses climbing the walls, wide stone steps at the foot. About 9 m wide.
use: The chapel at the top of the night square.

title: Half-timbered house front
subject: Subject: one town house, seen flat from the front, two storeys: dark timber framing over pale plaster, warm lit leaded windows with flower boxes of magenta flowers, an arched wooden door, a steep plum-red tile roof, and a small round turret with a conical roof at one corner. About 8 m wide.
use: The houses round the night square (left, right and front).

title: Iron railing section
subject: Subject: one section of black iron railing, seen flat from the front, about 3 m long and 1.2 m high: thin upright bars with spear-point tips, two cross bars, standing between two square grey stone posts with caps.
use: Round the graveyard and on the garden walls of the night square.

title: Magenta flower bush
subject: Subject: one low flowering bush, about 80 cm across and 60 cm high: dark green leaves and many small bright magenta-pink flowers. Night colours.
use: The flower beds round the night square.

title: Twisted dark tree
subject: Subject: one old twisted tree with no leaves, whole, about 10 m high: a thick knotted dark trunk and long writhing branches curling up and outwards, dark purple-brown bark with pale moonlit edges. Gloomy night colours.
use: The dark wood beyond the river in the night square.
